newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Commercial Bank FRCD increased to HK$550 mln.
newsitem.headline: Asia Commercial Bank FRCD increased to HK$550 mln.

text.p: Asia Commercial Bank's five-year floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to HK$550 million from HK$500 million because of oversubscription, arranger Tokai Asia said on Friday.
The certificates were issued at par to float at 60 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. There are put and call options in years three and four.
With fees, the all-in return for top tier managers is 83 basis points.
Lead managers are Schroders Asia, Tokai Asia and Commerz (East Asia), with HK$70 million each, Sakura Finance Asia, with HK$50 million.
Asia Commercial Bank shareholders Bangkok Bank and Tat Lee Bank through its Hong Kong Branch are lead managers with HK$45 million each.
Senior managers are Bayerische Vereinsbank, with HK$70 million, and Dresdner Bank's Hong Kong Branch, with HK$55 million.
Managers, with HK$25 million each, are Bank Brussels Lambert, Bank of Hawaii and Berliner Bank.
The payment date has not been fixed.
